decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted and numbered Planning and Heritage Statement, Figure 01, 02, 03 Rev 0, Received 23 December 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building is occupied).

Condition : 3 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the alteration or demolition of the brick boundary wall, except in so far as the alterations hereby approved.
description: Removal of the existing front gate to be replaced with a new higher aluminium powder coated front flood defence gate.
